name: John Tran
office: City of Rosemead, Member of the City Council

items.text: John Tran is a member of the Rosemead Traffic Commission. He was elected to the Rosemead City Council in 2005 and was mayor from 2007 to 2009. In 2013 he was convicted of attempted witness tampering and making false statements to the FBI. He admitted taking $38,000 from a developer while in office and served about 16 months in federal prison.

items.text: His campaign says he wants to strengthen public safety. He says as a councilmember he ensured law enforcement and firefighters were fully funded.
